texts.title: Stillwater Yoga
texts.content:
New to yoga? Your first class is on us!
Stillwater Yoga offers beginner classes every Tuesday and Thursday at 6 P.M.
Mats are provided, so just bring water and wear comfortable clothes.
Book online at stillwateryoga.com and enter code FIRSTFREE.
Offer valid for new students only.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?
options: C. To announce new class times for current members
questions.explanation: It invites people who are "New to yoga" to try a free first class, an offer "valid for new students only."

questions.stem: What should a person do to get the free class?
options: B. Visit on a Tuesday morning
C. Use a code when booking
D. Pay at the front desk
questions.explanation: People should "Book online at stillwateryoga.com and enter code FIRSTFREE."
